title: Uninclined
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 43.13 Linked Discourses 43.13
  • 2. Dutiyavagga Chapter Two

Anatasutta Uninclined

“Anatañca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, anatagāmiñca maggaṁ. “Mendicants, I will teach you the uninclined …” Taṁ suṇātha. Katamañca, bhikkhave, anataṁ …pe…”.

(Yathā asaṅkhataṁ tathā vitthāretabbaṁ.) (Tell in full as in the unconditioned in the previous chapter.)

Dutiyaṁ.
